## Orbit Ledger — account brief

A finance-operations SaaS for mid-market teams that raised a Series A in September and is hiring finance engineers.

### What they do
- Sells month-end close automation to mid-market finance teams. ([S1](https://orbit.example/))
- Plans start at $300 per month. ([S2](https://orbit.example/pricing))

### Recent events
- Raised a $12M Series A on 2026-09-22. ([S3](https://news.example.org/orbit-ledger-series-a))
- Head of Finance is Jo Rivera, per the enrichment record. (S4)

### Suggested next step
- Open with the month-end close timeline they describe on their blog.

### Unknowns
- Customer count: no public figure found.
